geographicCoverage.description: Commercial arable plots in Belgium (locations not given in the deposit)

title: Emergence-tent counts of 51 ground beetle species per tent and sampling week in Belgian sugar beet and winter cereal plots, 2023-2025
abstract: Carabid beetles in 37 commercial arable plots in Belgium followed through a sugar beet - winter cereal succession in two crop cycles (plots 1-20: sugar beet 2023, cereal 2024; plots 21-40: sugar beet 2024, cereal 2025), sampled in April, July and (sugar beet) October, three sampling weeks each. Emergence tents at five within-plot positions, catching beetles emerging from the enclosed soil. 1529 collections with status ok; 51 species caught.
samplingProtocol: Emergence tents at fixed positions in each plot (lines A-E) enclosing the soil surface, collected after each sampling week; three weeks per seasonal period.
surveyEvidenceNote: The deposited sheet has one row per trap collection with its status (Etat); a survey is a row with Etat = ok (1529 of 1665 tent rows). Absent, flooded (Inonde / Inondé), torn (Trouée), removed (Retire) and Vide collections are not surveys. Two rows mistyped as sampling week 2 are read as week 3 from their position in the sheet.
